signal: Onspring launched new AI capabilities for its GRC platform in June 2026

email.subject1: a signal play for Onspring SLED
email.body1:
Colleen, saw Onspring just launched AI capabilities across the GRC platform.

A launch like that lights up more SLED accounts than the team can work before procurement windows open, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Onspring off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Colleen, quick follow-up for Onspring SLED.

Public-sector cycles are long and timing-sensitive, so reps burn time on research and follow-up rather than working live opportunities. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your SLED team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Colleen, last bit of proof for Onspring.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Onspring's SLED reply rate likely compares to other public-sector GRC vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Colleen, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling SLED pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Public-sector timing is its own kind of busy, and the windows matter.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a SLED motion? I'll tailor it to Onspring either way.
